dict.string: Solos reads and adds calendar events when you ask it to.
Solos reads and adds reminders when you ask it to.
Solos looks up contacts by name when you ask it to.
Solos uses your location when you ask about weather, places or routes near you.
Solos lists your photos and copies the ones you choose into its workspace so a script can work on them.
Solos searches and plays music in your library when you ask it to.
Solos reads health data such as steps, heart rate, sleep and weight when you ask it to.
Solos records health data such as weight or water when you ask it to.
Solos sets alarms and timers when you ask it to.
